text: The repo-specific anchors called out by the skill are the `og` source entrypoint, the `og.py` wrapper or importable entrypoint, daemon runtime state under `.outcomegraph/work/daemon/`, the event ledger in `.outcomegraph/events/`, and work, claims, and certificate state under `.outcomegraph/work/`, `.outcomegraph/claims/`, and `.outcomegraph/certificates/`.
